payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Review manual transfers and their server-authoritative fulfillment record.
payments.plansPageDescription: Manage the offers customers see and can purchase without changing historical orders.
payments.catalogDescription: Manage the paid plans shown in public Pricing and available for manual purchase. Existing payment orders keep their original price, credits and entitlement snapshots.
payments.noPlans: No paid plans exist yet. Public Pricing keeps its structure and shows unavailable paid options.
payments.createHelp: Create only verified paid offers. No price is prefilled or published until you enter it and choose Active.
payments.slugHelp: Stable internal identifier. Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
payments.slugLockedHelp: Locked after creation because orders and integrations may rely on it.
payments.planTypeHelp: Choose one-time credits or a subscription entitlement.
payments.priceHelp: Whole DZD amount charged for this offer. Minimum 1 for purchasable plans.
payments.creditsHelp: Whole Unified Credits granted after verified approval. Minimum 1.
payments.displayOrderHelp: Lower numbers appear first in public Pricing.
payments.activeHelp: Customers can select and purchase this plan.
payments.featuredHelp: Visual recommendation only; it does not change price or entitlement.
payments.planCreated: Plan created and catalog data synchronized.
payments.planSaved: Saved. Canonical catalog data is now synchronized.
payments.validationSlug: Use 1–80 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores for the internal slug.
payments.validationDuplicateSlug: That internal slug is already used by another plan.
payments.validationPositive: Price and Unified Credits must be positive whole numbers for purchasable plans.
payments.validationOrder: Display order must be a whole number between -10,000 and 10,000.
payments.planActionFailed: The plan could not be saved. Your changes were preserved; check the values and try again.
payments.ordersDescription: Open an order to inspect its customer, transfer evidence, review status and immutable fulfillment record.
payments.noPaymentsForStatus: No payment orders have this status.
payments.reviewNotePlaceholder: Add a short reason or verification note
payments.reviewHelp: Approval grants the snapshotted credits exactly once. Rejection grants nothing.
payments.rejectedSuccess: Payment rejected and audit record updated.
payments.confirmApprove: Approve this payment? The snapshotted credits or entitlement will be granted exactly once.
payments.confirmReject: Reject this payment? No credits or entitlement will be granted.
payments.actionFailed: The payment action could not be completed. Your note was preserved; verify the current status before trying again.
